terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The proposed terms for using SmartPFE, an AI-assisted workspace for final-year projects, reports and defense preparation.

sections.title: 1. Who operates SmartPFE
paragraphs: SmartPFE is operated by Bee Coders in Tunisia. You can contact us at contact@9antra.tn. These terms cover the SmartPFE website and its project workspace.
sections.pending: Registered legal identity, business address, effective date, eligible ages and launch territories.

sections.title: 2. Your account
paragraphs: Provide accurate account information and keep your sign-in credentials secure. You can register with an email address and password or use Google sign-in. Contact us if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.
You are responsible for having permission to submit project information and recordings, including any information about other people or your internship company.

sections.title: 3. AI assistance and academic responsibility
paragraphs: SmartPFE supports planning, analysis, requirements, UML preparation, report drafting, presentations, speeches and practice jury sessions. It does not replace your supervisor, university requirements or your own work.

AI output can be inaccurate, incomplete, biased or similar to output provided to others. Verify facts, citations, technical claims and generated code before using them. Practice scores and feedback do not guarantee an academic result.
Follow your institution’s rules on AI, authorship, plagiarism and disclosure. Do not present fabricated research, sources or results as verified work.

sections.title: 4. Your content
paragraphs: You retain your rights in the content you provide. By submitting it, you authorize Bee Coders to store, process, format and transmit it as needed to provide the features you request, including processing by the service providers described in the Privacy Policy.
AI outputs may contain material subject to third-party rights. Review them before publishing or submitting them. Keep your own copies of important work using the available export tools.

sections.title: 5. Acceptable use
paragraphs: Do not use SmartPFE for unlawful activity, infringement, harassment or impersonation. Do not upload malware, attempt to access another user’s data, bypass access controls or manipulate credit balances or usage limits.
Do not submit passwords, API keys or confidential third-party material without authorization. Record other people only when you have the necessary permission.

sections.title: 6. Credits and payments
paragraphs: Some AI actions require credits. The workspace shows the applicable credit cost and available balance. Free allowances and purchased credits are managed separately.

The current purchase flow records a credit request. The team contacts you with payment instructions and adds purchased credits after payment verification. Sending a request alone does not confirm payment or add credits.

A generation that fails before producing usable output releases its reserved credits. Closing the page or disconnecting does not refund a successful generation. For streamed generations, credits are charged when generated content starts, even if you stop reading afterward. Technical credit reversals are separate from refunds of money paid. Contact us if your balance or purchase record appears incorrect.
sections.pending: Final paid offers, taxes, payment methods, credit validity or expiry, cancellation rules and monetary refunds. The landing page’s Premium/monthly offer also needs reconciliation with the credit purchase flow.

sections.title: 7. Third-party services
paragraphs: AI features send relevant project context, instructions and, when you request audio analysis, recordings to Google Gemini. Google sign-in and other external resources have their own terms and privacy practices. Details are described in our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 8. Availability and account closure
paragraphs: Features may be interrupted by maintenance, technical faults or provider limits. AI assistance and practice feedback do not guarantee accuracy, uninterrupted access or acceptance of your deliverables.
Contact Bee Coders if you wish to close your account or request deletion. The current app has no self-service account deletion control.
sections.pending: Account suspension and closure procedure, treatment of remaining purchased credits, notice periods and access to work after closure.

sections.title: 9. Legal rights and disputes
paragraphs: Nothing in these proposed terms is intended to remove rights that cannot be excluded under applicable law. Contact Bee Coders about a problem with the service or a purchase.
sections.pending: Applicable law and dispute process, warranty and liability provisions, and any requirements for consumers in the countries served.

sections.title: 10. Updates and contact
paragraphs: This draft will be updated as launch arrangements are confirmed. A final version needs an effective date and a process for communicating material changes.
For questions about these terms, contact contact@9antra.tn.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How SmartPFE handles account information, project content and recordings, based on the app’s current features.

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible
paragraphs: Bee Coders in Tunisia operates SmartPFE. For privacy questions or requests, email contact@9antra.tn. This policy covers information handled through the website, workspace and contact form.
sections.pending: Registered legal identity, business address, effective date and any required privacy representative.

sections.title: 2. Information you provide
paragraphs: Account information includes your name, email address, hashed password for password-based accounts, account role, verification and recovery information, and English/French interface preference. Google sign-in also provides a Google account identifier and may provide a profile image.

Project information includes titles, university and academic year, project descriptions, internship/company context, stakeholders, technologies, requirements, reports, diagrams, slides, speeches and other content you enter or save. Generated content and progress are stored with the project.

Credit requests include your name, email, phone number, requested credits, package, price and currency. Wallet activity, request status, administrator notes and receipt delivery status are also recorded.
The contact form collects your name, email, subject and message, which are sent to the configured team inbox.

sections.title: 3. Why information is processed
paragraphs: We use account information to provide sign-in, verification, account recovery and preferences. Project content is used to save your work and provide the AI, reporting and practice features you request.

Credit and transaction records support usage limits, balances, payment verification and receipts. Contact details support replies and service communications. Operational records support diagnosis of errors and service administration.
sections.pending: Applicable legal grounds for each purpose, any consent requirements and the final operational logging configuration.

sections.title: 4. AI and audio processing
paragraphs: When you request an AI feature, relevant project content and instructions are sent to Google Gemini. Retrieved examples from the report knowledge base can also be included in the prompt.

Jury practice and recorded answers send audio and project context to Gemini for analysis. The current app processes uploaded audio in server memory and saves analysis, recording metadata and, for question-and-answer sessions, transcripts. The current project records do not store the raw audio file. This does not describe Google’s retention of audio or prompts.

Google’s handling of prompts and outputs depends on the Gemini service and billing configuration. Unpaid-service terms can allow model improvement and human review; paid-service terms differ. We have not yet confirmed the production configuration, so this draft does not promise that provider processing excludes model improvement.
sections.pending: Production Gemini billing tier, applicable provider terms, provider retention and any other enabled AI services.

sections.title: 5. Who may receive information
paragraphs: The app stores account, project and credit records in MongoDB. Production hosting and database providers and their locations still need confirmation. Google processes AI requests and supports Google sign-in. The configured email service handles contact messages and transactional emails.
Administrative screens expose account details, project basics/descriptions/technical context, and credit purchase records to authorized administrators.

The backend includes optional Langfuse tracing. When configured, traces can include user identifiers, AI inputs, outputs and diagnostic metadata. Whether tracing will be enabled in production and where it will be hosted remain unconfirmed.

The website loads Google Fonts, Google sign-in resources and a PlantUML library from unpkg. Your browser connects to those providers, which can receive connection details such as your IP address and request metadata.
sections.pending: Final provider list, administrator access procedures, hosting countries and safeguards for any international transfers.

sections.title: 6. Browser storage and cookies
paragraphs: SmartPFE uses local browser storage for the sign-in token and user information, interface language, theme, onboarding drafts and pinned report tools. Session storage can hold the email address awaiting verification.

You can clear this data in your browser settings. Doing so can sign you out, reset preferences or remove a locally saved draft. Clearing browser storage does not delete your server-side account or project.
External sign-in and resource providers may use their own cookies or similar technologies. Their practices are separate from SmartPFE’s local storage.
sections.pending: Audit cookies and storage on the deployed site, including any hosting analytics or future trackers, and confirm consent requirements.

sections.title: 7. Retention and security
paragraphs: Account, project, credit and notification records are stored by the service. The current implementation does not establish a complete automatic retention or account-deletion schedule.

The app hashes account passwords and checks authentication and role permissions for protected features. These measures do not guarantee absolute security. Avoid submitting secrets or confidential material without permission.
sections.pending: Retention periods for accounts, projects, transactions, emails, logs, traces and backups; deletion procedure; production security and backup arrangements.

sections.title: 8. Your choices and requests
paragraphs: You can update supported account details, change interface preferences, edit your project and use the available exports. Audio features are optional and recording requires browser permission.

Email contact@9antra.tn to request access, correction, deletion or account closure, or ask about other rights available under the law that applies to you. We may need to verify your identity. The current app does not provide a self-service deletion button or a complete personal-data export.
Deleting browser storage, signing out or stopping use does not itself erase records held by Bee Coders or its providers.
sections.pending: Request verification process, response deadlines, handling of backups and legally required records, and the relevant supervisory authority.

sections.title: 9. Age eligibility
paragraphs: SmartPFE is designed for students preparing final-year projects. The minimum user age and any parental authorization requirements have not yet been finalized.
sections.pending: Minimum age, launch countries and the process for handling information from ineligible users.

sections.title: 10. Updates and contact
paragraphs: This draft will be revised when launch arrangements are confirmed. The final policy needs an effective date and a process for communicating material changes.
For privacy questions, contact Bee Coders at contact@9antra.tn.
